report.answer_text:
Anora won Best Picture at the 2025 Academy Awards (the 97th ceremony, held March 2, 2025). Sean Baker directed it. He also won Oscars that night for Best Director, Best Film Editing, and Best Original Screenplay. Mikey Madison won Best Actress for her lead role.
If you meant the 2026 ceremony, which honors 2025 films, let me know and I can look that up.
